name: Powerwell Holdings Berhad
overview: 2026年，Powerwell完成以RM16.66 million收购Tenaga Kenari Sdn Bhd和Tenaga Kenari Marketing Sdn Bhd各49%股权，并启动对两家休眠全资子公司DB Power Sdn Bhd和Powerwell Marketing Sdn Bhd的成员自愿清盘。110,400份凭单。
overview_en: In 2026, Powerwell completed the acquisition of 49% equity interest each in Tenaga Kenari Sdn Bhd and Tenaga Kenari Marketing Sdn Bhd for a total cash consideration of RM16.66 million, and commenced members' voluntary winding-up of two dormant wholly-owned subsidiaries, DB Power Sdn Bhd and Powerwell Marketing Sdn Bhd. The company also proposed a bonus issue of 116,110,400 warrants on the basis of 1 warrant for every 5 existing ordinary shares.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 完成收购两家公司各49%股权，并对两家休眠子公司启动自愿清盘。
segments.note_en: Completed acquisition of 49% equity interest in two companies and commenced voluntary winding-up of two dormant subsidiaries.

actions.title: WINDING UP / RECEIVER & MANAGER / RESTRAINING ORDER / SPECIAL ADMINISTRATOR
actions.text: 对全资子公司DB Power Sdn Bhd及Powerwell Marketing Sdn Bhd启动成员自愿清盘，两家公司已停止业务并处于休眠状态。
actions.text_en: Commenced members' voluntary winding-up of wholly-owned subsidiaries DB Power Sdn Bhd and Powerwell Marketing Sdn Bhd, which have ceased business operations and are dormant.

actions.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS
actions.text: 以RM16.66 million现金完成收购Tenaga Kenari Sdn Bhd及Tenaga Kenari Marketing Sdn Bhd各49%股权，余额已于2026年4月1日付清。
actions.text_en: Completed the acquisition of 49% equity interest each in Tenaga Kenari Sdn Bhd and Tenaga Kenari Marketing Sdn Bhd for a total cash consideration of RM16.66 million, with the balance purchase consideration fully paid on 1 April 2026.

model_changes.title: WINDING UP / RECEIVER & MANAGER / RESTRAINING ORDER / SPECIAL ADMINISTRATOR
model_changes.text: 通过清盘两家休眠子公司精简集团架构，减少行政与合规成本。
model_changes.text_en: Streamlined the corporate structure by winding up two dormant subsidiaries to reduce ongoing administrative and compliance costs.
